body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 3-month rates for the 2-bedroom apartment at The Residences W3, Downtown Dubai:

October: AED 32,500
November: AED 32,500
December: AED 32,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-downtown-dubai-the-residences-the-residences-1-104124474.html

*
Please also note that the rate displayed online is applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The above rates are applicable to your requested dates.
*

To secure the 3-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the apartment and secure the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
